item.text:
Implemented [run.sh](/work/run.sh). Run:

```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

It labels two speakers, requests server-side redaction of names, SSNs, and phone numbers, writes the required JSON, and never deletes AssemblyAI transcripts.

The sample succeeded, the retained server text matched the redacted output, and all five local tests passed.

PII detection can miss entities, so review is still necessary for a strict no-PII requirement.
